title: Nearby Sacred Temples — Healing & Ashram Sanctuaries (Batch J + Sharada Peeth)
description: For each healing/ashram sanctuary temple from Batch J plus Sharada Peeth, nearby sacred temples that exist. Covers Kainchi Dham, Prasanthi Nilayam (Puttaparthi), Akshardham Delhi, Shirdi Sai Baba, Auroville Matrimandir, ISKCON Vrindavan, Art of Living Bangalore, Arunachaleswarar (Tiruvannamalai), and Sharada Peeth. Researched from official websites, Incredible India, state tourism, and pilgrimage guides.

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bhumika Mandir (Darshani Darwaza)
nearby_sacred_temples.distance: Start of trek, ~1.5 km from Katra
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Mata first appeared to the devotee; temple marks the entrance to the yatra

data.location: Tirumala, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, India
data.significance: Richest and most visited Hindu temple in the world. One of 108 Divya Desams. Vishnu as Srinivasa/Balaji. On Tirumala hills (7 peaks representing Adisesha). 2,500+ daily visitors.

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Padmavathi Ammavari Temple (Tiruchanur)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Consort of Lord Venkateswara; Goddess Padmavathi/Alamelumanga; visit before Tirumala darshan for good fortune

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sri Kapileswara Swamy Temple (Kapila Theertham)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Shiva temple at foot of Tirumala hills; waterfall enters Pushkarini; idol installed by Sage Kapila

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient Vishnu temple consecrated by Ramanujacharya (1130 CE); one of biggest complexes in Tirupati

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Srikalahasteeswara Temple (Srikalahasti)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Pancha Bhoota Stalam (Vayu/Wind); Shiva as Kalahasteeswara; Rahu-Ketu dosha remedies

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sri Kalyana Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Srinivasa Mangapuram)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Venkateswara stayed for 6 months after marrying Padmavathi; ASI-protected monument

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Silathoranam (Natural Arch, Tirumala)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Natural geological arch (8m wide, 3m high); National Geo-heritage Monument; 1.5 billion years old

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Akasa Ganga Waterfall (Tirumala)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred waterfall; where Garuda brought water for Venkateswara; papavinasanam theertham nearby

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sri Venugopala Swamy Temple (Tirupati)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Krishna temple as flute-playing Venugopala; ancient Vaishnava shrine

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Chandragiri Fort & Raja Mahal
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Historical fort of Vijayanagara Empire; where Vijayanagara kings ruled after Fall of Hampi; Light & Sound show

metadata.note: This covers all temples from Batch J (Healing & Ashram Sanctuaries) plus Sharada Peeth, which was separately researched. The Arunachaleswarar Temple at Tiruvannamalai, while technically a Pancha Bhoota Stalam (covered in Batch B), is included here because of its deep connection to healing, meditation, and the Ramana Maharshi lineage.
